what pompeii tells us about
everyday roman life

79 ad

vesuvius froze a whole city
in a single day.

bread still in the ovens

loaves carbonised
in the bakeries.

fast food

street counters served
hot meals: "thermopolia".

graffiti

love notes, jokes and insults
on the walls.

"cave canem"

"beware of the dog",
in a floor mosaic.

the casts

in 1863, fiorelli filled the empty
spaces with plaster. i learned this
in a five-minute lesson.
